_doc: Shot list. 'at' anchors the cut to a spoken word: '<sentence id>:<word as written in narration.json>' (cut lands ~4 frames before the word). 'need' is the GTA VI footage to place in the slot (official Rockstar trailers / officially released footage only). 'type' = motion typography cue shown over the shot.

shots.need: Vice City skyline at dawn/dusk, slow aerial push-in (official trailer establishing shot)
shots.visual: Slow push-in on the Vice City skyline; dark, moody grade

shots.need: Packed beach or club crowd, many people on screen
Wide aerial of the city at night, lights to the horizon
shots.visual: City lights to the horizon — 'all over the world'

shots.need: Fast car crossing a causeway/bridge at speed
shots.visual: Energy cut on the title — GTA VI title typography

shots.need: Iconic hero landscape: flamingos / palm trees at golden hour
shots.visual: Iconic, monumental shot — 'in video game history'

shots.need: Jason — close-up, clear face
shots.visual: Jason close-up; name tag lands on the word 'Джейсон'

shots.need: Lucia — close-up, clear face
Jason and Lucia side by side (walking / standing together)
Jason & Lucia in the robbery moment (masks, cash) — trust vs money
shots.visual: Trust vs money — 'где доверие может стоить дороже денег'

shots.need: Police lights / pursuit
Consequence: arrest / handcuffs / Lucia in prison scene
Vice City aerial in daylight — the definitive establishing shot
shots.visual: Welcome to Vice City — location title

shots.need: Neon-lit street at night (Ocean Drive-style strip)
Highway / causeway traffic, car driving away to the horizon
Beach at night with party / neon nightlife by the water (or beach -> club within one clip)
Golden-hour city atmosphere (marina, boats, sunset haze)
Street-level life detail: locals, small-town corner, gas station
Wide cinematic landscape shot showing visual fidelity (sky, water, light)
Close details of characters & surfaces: faces, clothing, reflections, props
Wildlife & nature: alligator, swamp/Everglades-style wetlands, flamingos
shots.visual: The surrounding world — nature and wildlife

shots.need: Busy city: traffic and pedestrians, living streets
Small human moments (social-media style clips from the trailer, people in daily life)
shots.visual: Small details that pull players back

shots.need: Car driving into the sunset / returning to the city
Massive night aerial of Vice City
Open-world vista with freedom of movement: speedboat / plane over open water and coastline
shots.visual: A new level of open world, freedom

shots.need: Cinematic character moment of Jason & Lucia (dramatic framing)
Tension: police helicopter spotlight / standoff
shots.visual: The doubt — can it live up to the hype?

shots.need: Lucia close-up, looking into frame — strongest character shot
Strongest cinematic shot: Jason & Lucia in the car, sunset (hero shot)
Hero skyline of Vice City at golden hour
In-game social-media / livestream style clip from the official trailer (people filming, viral moments)
Slow-motion action beat: pursuit / heist
Spectacle: night city, lights, crowds
shots.visual: How loud the premiere will be

shots.need: Jason & Lucia, iconic hero framing
Final iconic shot: Vice City skyline at sunset (slow), holds under the end card
shots.visual: '…превзойти собственную легенду' -> end card GTA VI / ПРЕВЗОЙТИ ЛЕГЕНДУ?
